evidence: Implement one provider module behind the existing shared adapter interface. The observed gap is an unimplemented query path; the benefit is a usable read-only result. The registry, queue and cache add unsupported cost (A1-A3).

Preserve all three deliverables: query adapter, sanitized error contract and recorded query result. Keep provider I/O, credentials references and dependencies owned by shared infrastructure; expose explicit query input, result and typed failure contracts to the consumer.

Build the atomic provider capability, then one synthetic input-to-consumer-result E2E. Record its input, output and synthetic provenance. Follow with a bounded isolated provider query when authorized access is available; record sanitized evidence before claiming provider success. Defer broad abstraction and performance expansion absent a demonstrated need.
A small implementation slice is justified; no query execution or implementation success is established. Synthetic evidence would establish only the synthetic path, not provider or host readiness.
Do not enable scheduled host use or hot-add active MCP entries. F2-F4 demonstrate data-loss, secret-exposure and duplicate-effect risks; F1 establishes only synthetic happy-path success.

Use F2-F4 as minimal failing reproductions and trace the writer, serializer and retry boundaries before each repair. Publish a complete validated result by atomic replacement; injected mid-write failure must preserve the previous valid bytes.

Replace raw provider-response serialization with an allowlisted sanitized error contract and nested redaction at every output boundary. Synthetic secret sentinels must be absent from success/error logs and artifacts.

Stop unchanged permanent-authentication retries. Bound transient retries and timeouts. Treat the timed-out refresh as unknown outcome: reconcile remote status before replay, or reuse a supported stable idempotency key; never generate a new operation ID to blindly retry it.

Do not promote on this evidence. Reject 'independent corroboration and proven net alpha'; incremental value remains inconclusive, rather than disproven. Shared announcements and 0.98 correlation undermine independence (S1).
